---
title: "linkrot: skip-patterns"
filters:
  - linkrot
extensions:
  linkrot:
    timeout: 5
    output-file: report.txt
    skip-patterns:
      - "linkrot%-test%.invalid/skipped"
      - "(unclosed"
---

- [Skipped by a Lua pattern](https://linkrot-test.invalid/skipped)
- [Skipped by a malformed pattern, matched as plain text](https://linkrot-test.invalid/(unclosed)
- [Checked and broken](https://linkrot-test.invalid/missing)
